subject: Exception Request — Quarterly Billing Cadence & Net-90 for AstralPay POC
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@astralpay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@astralpay.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Billing cadence for POC — ask

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed. We have one procurement constraint I need your help with: for the 3-month POC we run with you, Procurement requires quarterly invoicing and a Net-90 payment term on the pilot invoice. They won’t sign under standard Net-30 terms for pilot-stage vendors.

Is this something Redwood can make an exception for? If needed, we can route an approved PO but they need invoice frequency aligned with calendar quarter and a 90-day payment window. Attached is our standard PO template (procurement asked to include it).

Appreciate a quick confirmation — procurement is on a tight review cycle.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Strategic Partnerships
AstralPay
[Attachment: AstralPay_PO_template.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement Deals <deals@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 13:22:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Billing cadence for POC — ask

Team — forwarding AstralPay request. They’re asking for quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for a 3-month POC. Key points:
- POC ARR: $42k (monthly equivalent $14k)
- Customer is asking to receive a single invoice covering the quarter with payment Net-90
- They can provide a PO if we accept non-standard terms

My read: this is moderately sized for a strategic POC and AstralPay is a potential logo for our payment vertical. Requesting deal desk + exec approval for a 90-day term on the pilot only (no change to our public T&Cs for hosted accounts).

Ask: Vivek — can you approve Net-90 for this pilot? Grace — any legal concerns we should flag (SLA, collections, revenue recognition notes)? Karthik — if this lands, can you update billing schedule and HubSpot deal to reflect the exception?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Billing cadence for POC — ask

Hannah — ok to grant a temporary exception for AstralPay’s POC with the following conditions:
1) Exception limited to this 3-month pilot only; standard Net-30 terms resume for any post-PO production contract.
2) We require a signed PO that references our MSA and includes a clause that invoice disputes must be raised within 30 days of receipt.
3) Finance to record a memo on the deal file noting the Net-90 exception for audit purposes.
4) No change to pricing or discounts — this is purely a billing cadence exception.

Grace — confirm the PO/MA language is sufficient for us to accept Net-90 from a legal/compliance perspective. Karthik — please spin up an invoice schedule config for quarterly issuance and add the exception flag in HubSpot.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Billing cadence for POC — ask

Vivek/Hannah — I reviewed the PO template they sent. Two recommended edits before acceptance:
- Add explicit reference that the invoice is for the pilot period only and does not alter the terms of any future SOWs.
- Insert the dispute window clause (30 days) and a billing contact for AstralPay to route questions.

If AstralPay can return the PO with those two lines included we can sign off from legal. I’ll also add a short memo to the deal file to capture the exception rationale.

Grace Oconnor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@astralpay.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@astralpay.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 11:15:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Billing cadence for POC — ask

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. We can accept quarterly invoicing with Net-90 on the pilot under a one-off exception. To summarize the agreement and next steps:

- Exception: Quarterly invoice for the 3-month pilot, Net-90 payment term. Exception applies to POC invoice only; standard terms apply for any subsequent agreements.
- Required: AstralPay to return a signed PO that: (a) references Redwood’s MSA, (b) includes the pilot-only clause, and (c) includes the 30-day dispute window and billing contact.
- Finance: Karthik will configure quarterly invoice issuance and add exception memo to the HubSpot deal record (Deal ID: RWI-2025-447).
- Legal: Grace has pre-approved the language edits; please incorporate them into the PO.

Please send the revised PO (or confirm if we should push a short addendum instead) and I’ll route to finance for invoice scheduling. Attaching our draft invoice terms for your procurement team’s reference.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference
